actors.name: Javier Milei
actors.blurb: Milei generated high-profile news coverage during his visit to Madrid for the Ibero-American Summit, where he sparked diplomatic friction by equating socialism with fascism during speeches alongside Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez. He also held a key bilateral meeting with Vox leader Santiago Abascal while continuing to face domestic trade union protests and economic opposition at home.
